'''icebreath Understanding''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 19 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|ECC-L-quietminingcolony.gif|label=Quiet Mining Colony}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Quiet Mining Colony
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 QMC icebreath LS 2004 5854.txt|Download]] (omits Weather Vane (V) (Light), Luke Skywalker (V), Princess Leia (V), Lobot (V), Leia's Sporting Blaster (V), Surreptitious Glance (V), Computer Interface (V), Imperial Atrocity (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

My best QMC.

'Defensive Shields - 10', all named (the Reflections III shields; Affect Mind (V) from Virtual Set 2).

== Notes ==

* The four decks are the author's farewell set and post many unique cards in multiples (here Princess Leia (V) x4 and Artoo-Detoo In Red 5 x4); dested as posted.
* Original-era (V): Luke Skywalker (V) (VS1); Affect Mind (V) (VS2, shield); Leia's Sporting Blaster (V) (VS3); Weather Vane (V), Princess Leia (V) x4, Lobot (V), Surreptitious Glance (V) x2, Computer Interface (V), Imperial Atrocity (V) (VS6). The draft had read Princess Leia (V) as Leia (V) and dropped the (V) on Computer Interface and Imperial Atrocity.
* Posted 'Pucamir Thryss' dested Pucumir Thryss.

== Strategy ==

First of four decks.  My final contributions to SWCCG.
